note: Single source for glossary entries and jargon tooltips. Rendered into docs/GLOSSARY.html and title attributes by tools/build_site.py.

entries.body: The private trial file. In the terminal client it is access.json. It contains the signing seed and the account token. The MCP configuration is a second file, mcp.json, and contains the bearer token only. Keep both outside an agent chat.

entries.tooltip: The account credential. It is not a signature and it does not pay.
entries.body: The account credential in the MCP configuration’s Authorization header. That file does not contain the signing seed. It is not itself an approval of a deal or a payment.
The identifier of one exact agreement. Keep the expected agreement ID separately from any shortened summary. The source order and the final payment-enabled agreement have different IDs.
The retained key for one operation. A retry uses the identical operation, unchanged fields, and its original request key.
For a marketplace successor agreement, the market package includes the original advert, order, fee disclosure and full payment requests. Approving the source does not approve the successor.
The wallet-instruction example names the payment leg give-0 on an original source deal that uses Base or Ethereum USDC.
The seller uses destination. The payer uses sender. The instruction names a wallet. It alone does not authorize spending.

entries.tooltip: Six-decimal token units. 25 USDC = 25,000,000 micro-units. Not a dollar conversion.
entries.body: Base and Ethereum USDC amounts on the payments page use six-decimal micro-units. 25 USDC = 25,000,000 micro-units. That is a token amount, not a dollar conversion.
A field on the named asset in the USDC examples. Those examples show it as an empty object. Naming the asset does not, by itself, move the tokens.

entries.tooltip: A draft you swap by hand today. A recorded offer is coming soon.
entries.body: A proposed set of terms: the work, the price, the deadline and how the result will be checked. Today an offer is a draft you send yourself, by email or chat. The public server does not deliver it and does not mark one draft as the open offer. A recorded offer is coming soon.

entries.tooltip: A new draft that changes the price or the deadline. A recorded counter-offer is coming soon.
entries.body: A new draft that changes the other side’s terms, such as the price or the number of days. Today you write that new draft and swap it by hand. There is no counter-offer action on the public server. A recorded counter-offer is coming soon.

After the terms change, everyone who must agree has to approve the new exact version. An earlier approval stays with the earlier version. The public comparison asks for this when the two copies differ, including when the only difference is the order of the same clauses.

A cap on what an agent may agree, such as up to £130. This cap is not available on the public tools or the hosted account tools. A budget limit is coming soon. The open server change is pull request 192. That link does not mean the pull request already adds amount caps.

In the browser sandbox, test money moves into a hold when the sample is funded, and the buyer releases it after delivery. Those are test units, not real USDC. On the hosted USDC route there is no hold. Payment is a direct transfer and it is final.

entries.tooltip: A third party in the browser sample. Hosted USDC does not require one.
entries.body: A named third party in the local sandbox sample, used when a job is disputed there. The hosted USDC path does not require a resolver. A hosted dispute is a signed record between the buyer and the seller. The fee recipient is not required to co-sign that dispute.

entries.tooltip: The public tool connection. It can draft. It cannot sign, publish, pay or refund.
entries.body: The public tool connection. It can search and draft. It cannot sign, publish, pay or refund.

entries.tooltip: The engine name under Covenant. The native payment network is not live.
entries.body: The engine name under Covenant. The native payment network is not live.

entries.tooltip: The payer’s choice to add the posted fee. It defaults to off.
entries.body: The payer’s choice to add a platform fee. The fee is not set yet, so this choice does not add an amount. The owner will confirm this.

entries.tooltip: The signature type used by the account tools.
entries.body: The signature type used by the account tools.

entries.tooltip: A link to the previous draft. A public draft refuses it.
entries.body: A link to the previous draft. A public draft refuses it. Each public draft stands alone.

entries.tooltip: A network id in the payment catalogue. Naming it does not move money.
entries.body: A network id in the payment catalogue. Naming it does not move money.

entries.tooltip: The browser sample can hold test funds. Hosted USDC does not. That payment is final.
entries.body: The browser sample can hold test funds. Hosted USDC does not. That payment is final.
